capabilities: Check selected text or the whole note for grammar and spelling errors with clickable suggestions
Toggle automatic checking while writing and clear leftover underlines
Auto-detect the note's language or pin a static language, including mixed languages in one document
Add or remove words in a custom spellchecker dictionary
Override configuration per note via properties and use LanguageTool Premium with an API key
extras: Unofficial plugin: the README asks users to report bugs to this repository, not to LanguageTool. Privacy-conscious users are pointed to self-hosting LanguageTool; premium features need a paid account and API key.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of the original obsidian-languagetool-plugin, with the following changes
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck only catches spelling in one language per session and does not check grammar.
